Chapter 6759: Events Of The Past

Chapter 6759: Events Of The Past

“Neither appears plausible.” Xiaoyue denied: “All along, Skykiller and Phoenix Queen’s love was eternal, withstanding the rest of time. No other dao companions compared to them.”

“I see, when a love lasts that long, it is harder to destroy than eternity itself.” Li Qiye nodded.

“Thus, Skykiller never left Divine Firmament after her death, wanting to pass away with her.” She said.

Their love stood strong regardless of the changing times. In Heaven Realm, there were stronger immortals with greater bloodlines than Skykiller True Dragon.

In terms of dao fortune, he couldn’t compare to Heavenfall or Dust. As for innate gifts, Mang had something superior.

However, they all envied him because he had such a wonderful dao companion. The legend of their love endured for eons in the Heaven Realm.

Therefore, Xiaoyue denied the possibility of Skykiller having an illegitimate offspring.

“Remnant true dragon bloodlines don’t have to come from Skykiller, he’s not the only true dragon.” She said.

“So either another true dragon or someone else used a method to pass down the bloodline.” He said.

“It should be difficult because other races can’t endure the bloodline, let alone continue it.” She said.

“There’s logic in this, given how the primordials don’t have a single descendant. At the very least, the divine branch managed to have offspring.” He said.

“Yes, and the true dragon bloodline isn’t the only one spread in diluted versions. Other beast races are there too.” She said.

“If it were so easy, there would be many more illegitimate offspring, right?” He said.

“Yes, that’s why I think any continuation is implausible.” She said.

“I can say with certainty that despite logic saying otherwise, all faint bloodlines in the mortal world can still be traced back to Divine Firmament.” He said.

“It’s a problem indeed.” She sighed.

“You also know that creating life might not be out of the question, but if one could create a race, why bother recreating the divine beast race?” He said: “If it were me, I would start a new race, one never seen before. Even the villainous heaven, bored as can be, wouldn’t do so. The divine beasts are already there with perfected gifts, it seems like a waste of time. This adds to the notion that these bloodlines, however impure, must be from Divine Firmament.”

“I can’t refute this.” She said.

“Furthermore, regardless of the devious methods, the fundamental process must still have originated from the divine beasts or their support.” He continued.

“The natural order dictates that the continuation of the perfect bloodlines can only be done by mature divine beasts. It’s why they are so few in number.” She said.

Any perversion of the bloodline always resulted in an early death for the offspring. This was why despite being one of the oldest races, the divine beasts suffered in quantity.

“Do you see her? She has both the gluttonous beast bloodline on top of the cosmic ancestral dragon bloodline, hence the starlight release.” He said.

“As you said, the cosmic ancestral dragon bloodline is a mature true dragon bloodline. Nonetheless, the true dragon bloodline might not be its source.” She said.

“Then where did it come from? The cosmic ancestral dragon didn’t appear out of thin air. How did the Demon Beast Epoch have so many divine bloodlines?” He asked.

“This epoch is just like the nine worlds. It is outside of Heaven Realm and the three thousand worlds. I have never seen Demon Beast before when it was around.” She said.

“The villainous heaven didn’t need to create a new race with a new epoch, it would be entirely unnecessary.” He said.

“Cosmic ancestral dragon...” She focused on the girl’s aura.

She found the gluttonous beast bloodline familiar, but not the draconic bloodline. There must be another bloodline even before the true dragon bloodline, if one went back far enough.

“Another lifeform.” She said.

“Unfortunately, I was not born in that era so I cannot speculate on this lifeform.” He shook his head.
